set.body:
Compile typed studies into direct-sum operators without confusing objectives with geometry.

Acceptance:
- Add direct-sum row and feature spaces and use linalg block-diagonal operators where appropriate.
- Add BlockDesign separate from row correspondence.
- Add distinct MaximizeAssociation, PenalizeDisagreement, and ConstrainEqualScores problem types.
- Add first-class LinearConstraint B with hard, quadratic-penalty, and bounded semantics.
- Compile hub-aligned, pairwise-linked, independent, and same-row studies into explicit block operators.
- Distinguish certified PSD RowGeometry, PSD ConstraintPenalty, and potentially indefinite SymmetricObjectiveForm.
- Add AdjointConsistent, MarginalConsistent, CycleConsistent, HubFactorized, and GlobalBlockPSD certificates where justified; do not infer global coherence from pairwise shape checks.
- Record exact objective formulas, constraints, normalization, solver formulation, and solved-to-reported objective relationship.
- Demonstrate the design through at least one real partially aligned multiset method rather than only synthetic operator construction.
- Test identity-alignment reduction, hub PSD, agreement-penalty PSD, hard-agreement residuals, and rejection of incompatible relation kinds on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: multivar constitution: direct-sum studies and nominal multiset objectives
